runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-888-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-889-Common issues:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-890-- Bot only responds in DMs or explicit mentions: enable MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT, then re-invite the bot if needed
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-891-- "Privileged Intents" error: enable MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT in Discord Developer Portal; verified apps may also need Discord approval
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:892:- Bot offline: Check `nullclaw service status`, verify token hasn't been reset
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:893:- No response in guilds: Check `require_mention` setting, verify Read Messages permission
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-894-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:895:### `memory`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-896-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:897:- `backend`: start with `sqlite`. Available engines: `sqlite`, `markdown`, `clickhouse`, `postgres`, `redis`, `lancedb`, `lucid`, `memory` (LRU), `api`, `none`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:898:- `auto_save`: persists conversation memory automatically.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-899-- For hybrid retrieval and embedding settings, see root `config.example.json`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-900-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:901:**Note**: The `markdown_only` memory profile automatically enables hybrid retrieval with temporal decay (half-life 30 days) for optimal relevance scoring. This ensures temporal awareness even with plain markdown files.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-902-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-903-### `gateway`
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-991-- `level`: start with `supervised`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-992-- `level = "yolo"`: bypasses command policy checks; use only for trusted local debugging.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:993:- `workspace_only`: keep `true` to limit file access scope.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-994-- `max_actions_per_hour`: keep conservative limits first.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-995-- `block_high_risk_commands` (default: `true`): blocks destructive commands such as `rm`, `sudo`, `mkfs`, `dd`, `shutdown`, `ssh`.
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1003-- `audit.enabled = true`: recommended for traceability.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1004-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1005:### Advanced: Web Search + Full Shell (high risk)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1006-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1007-Use only in controlled environments:
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1012-    "enabled": true,
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1013-    "allowed_domains": ["192.168.1.10", "*.internal.example.com"],
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1014:    "search_base_url": "https://searx.example.com",
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1015:    "search_provider": "auto",
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1016:    "search_fallback_providers": ["jina", "duckduckgo"]
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1017-  },
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1018-  "autonomy": {
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1029-Notes:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1030-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1031:- `search_base_url` (for web_search tool): Must be `https://host[/search]` or a local/private `http://host[:port][/search]` URL. HTTP is allowed only for localhost/private hosts (e.g., `http://localhost:8888`, `http://192.168.1.10:8888`). This URL is used by the `web_search` tool to query SearXNG instances.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1032-- `allowed_commands: ["*"]` and `allowed_paths: ["*"]` significantly widen execution scope.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1033:- `http_request.allowed_domains`: Domains that bypass SSRF protection for the `http_request` and `web_fetch` tools.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1034-  - `[]` (empty): All domains go through SSRF check (default, safest).
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1035-  - `["example.com"]`: Only specified domains skip SSRF protection.
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1037-  - `["192.168.1.10"]`: IP addresses can also be allowlisted (exact match only, CIDR ranges not supported).
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1038-  - `["*"]`: **DANGEROUS** - All domains skip SSRF protection and DNS pinning. Use only in trusted network environments where you control DNS and need to allow access to any IP address. This effectively disables SSRF protection.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1039:  - **Example**: If your SearXNG runs on `192.168.1.10`, add `"192.168.1.10"` to access it via `http_request` tool.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1040-  - **Security trade-off**: Allowlisted domains skip DNS pinning, allowing access to private IPs. This trades DNS rebinding protection for operational flexibility.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1041:  - **HTTPS-only policy**: The `http_request` and `web_fetch` tools require `https://` URLs. Plain HTTP is rejected for security. Note: This does not affect `web_search` tool's `search_base_url` which allows HTTP for local hosts.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1042-  - **Check order**: Allowlist is checked BEFORE DNS resolution to prevent DNS exfiltration attacks.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1043-
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1046-After each config change:

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md:1048:```bash
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/configuration.md-1049-nullclaw doctor

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-159-Common causes:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-160-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:161:- Low-quota coding plans may reject tool-heavy agent turns even when plain chat still works.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:162:- Retry pressure is too aggressive for the current provider plan.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-163-- There is no configured fallback when the primary provider hits quota/rate limits.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-183-If you have multiple keys for the same provider, add `reliability.api_keys` so NullClaw can rotate them.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-184-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:185:### 6) Local Ollama model says it has no access to `scheduler_tool`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-186-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-187-What this usually means:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-188-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:189:- The canonical NullClaw tool name is `schedule`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:190:- Some local Ollama-served models emit `scheduler_tool` or `schedule_tool` instead.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-191-- Current NullClaw builds normalize those Ollama aliases back to `schedule` before dispatch.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-192-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-193-Checks:
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md-194-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:195:- Confirm you are running a build that includes the Ollama tool-alias normalization fix.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:196:- Re-run with `nullclaw agent --verbose` if you still see `Unknown tool` for a scheduler-related name.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/usage.md:197:- If you are pinned to an older binary, upgrade before changing your scheduler config. The problem is usually tool-name drift, not a disabled scheduler.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md-51-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md-52-### Interactive model routing
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md-57-- If a routed provider is temporarily rate-limited or out of credits, `/model` shows that route as degraded until its cooldown expires.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md-58-- `/model` also lists configured auto routes with their `cost_class` and `quota_class` metadata.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md:59:- `/model <provider/model>` pins the current session to that model and disables automatic routing.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md:60:- `/model auto` clears the user pin, restores the configured default model, and re-enables `model_routes` for later turns in the same session.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md:61:- If no `model_routes` are configured, `/model auto` still clears the pin and returns the session to the configured default model.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md-62-- Starting `nullclaw agent` with `--model` or `--provider` also pins the run and bypasses `model_routes`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md-63-- Starting `nullclaw agent` with `--skill <name>` activates that skill before the first message or REPL turn.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/commands.md:64:- `nullclaw acp` speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC on stdio. Editors create ACP sessions with an absolute `cwd`; NullClaw forwards that cwd as the workspace for `agent invoke`.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/zig-installation.md:6:prebuilt NullClaw package. It does not require a local Zig toolchain:

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/zig-installation.md:13:need the exact pinned Zig 0.16.0 toolchain.

--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md-27-- Subsystems are abstracted via interfaces using `ptr: *anyopaque + vtable`.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md-28-- Runtime implementation is selected through factories.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md:29:- Provider/channel/tool/memory swaps should not require core orchestration rewrites.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md-30-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md-31-## Subsystems and Extension Points

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md-36-| Channels | `Channel` | CLI, Telegram, Signal, Discord, Slack, Matrix, WhatsApp, Nostr, IRC, Lark, Line, DingTalk, Email, OneBot, QQ, MaixCam, Mattermost, iMessage, Web, Teams, Max | Add channel implementation + register |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md:37:| Memory | `Memory` | SQLite (hybrid retrieval), Markdown, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Redis, LanceDB, Lucid, LRU, API, None | Add memory backend |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/architecture.md:38:| Tools | `Tool` | shell, file_read, file_write, file_edit, file_edit_hashed, file_read_hashed, file_append, http_request, web_fetch, web_search, delegate, screenshot, browser_open, and 20+ more | Add tool implementation |

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:67:## Shell 环境变量
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-68-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:69:默认情况下，只有最小的安全环境变量集（`PATH`、`HOME`、`TERM` 等）会传递给 shell 子进程，防止 API 密钥泄露（CWE-200）。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-70-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-71-### 路径验证环境变量
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-73-某些部署场景（如 Kubernetes 中通过 volume mount 注入工具链）需要 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 等环境变量来定位共享库，但无条件传递这类变量存在库注入风险。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-74-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:75:`tools.path_env_vars` 允许指定值为平台路径列表（Unix 用 `:`，Windows 用 `;`）的环境变量。每个路径组件在传递给子进程前都会经过以下验证：
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-76-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-77-1. 每个组件必须是绝对路径
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-84-```json
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-85-{
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:86:  "autonomy": { "allowed_paths": ["/opt/tools"] },
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:87:  "tools": { "path_env_vars": ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "PYTHONHOME", "NODE_PATH"] }
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-88-}
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-89-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-90-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:91:以上述配置为例，当容器环境中 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/tools/usr/lib:/opt/tools/lib` 时，shell tool 会验证两个路径组件均在 `/opt/tools`（通过 `allowed_paths`）范围内，然后放行。而攻击者控制的值如 `/tmp/evil:/opt/tools/lib` 会被拒绝，因为 `/tmp/evil` 不在工作区或允许路径内。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-92-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-93-## 高风险配置提醒

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:105:## 工作区密钥审计 (Workspace Secret Audit)
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-106-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:107:`nullclaw workspace audit` 用于扫描工作区、已暂存的 Git diff 或某个 Git 修订区间，检测疑似密钥泄漏。检测完全在本机执行，输出 JSON 形式适配 CI 集成。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-108-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-109-### 检测内容
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-129-| 行上下文掩码（如 `KEY=<SECRET:len=40,charset=base64url,entropy=5.3>`） | 周围非白名单的词 |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-130-| 经白名单过滤的 `nearby_keywords`（约 60 个 security/service 通用词） | 客户名、内部主机名、业务标识 |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:131:| 确定性标志：`is_test_path`、`is_example_file`、`is_in_comment`、`is_in_docstring` | LLM 对这些标志的推断 |
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-132-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-133-Envelope 模式带版本（`schema_version: "1"`），并附带每条 envelope 的 SHA-256 `envelope_hash` 用于可追溯性。

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-137-- `--llm-triage off`（默认）— 不调用 LLM；与基线扫描结果一致
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-138-- `--llm-triage dry-run` — 仅打印将要发送的 envelope（输出到 stderr），不发起任何网络请求。建议在启用前用此模式确认实际离开本机的内容
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md:139:- `--llm-triage external` — 通过已配置 provider vtable 提交 envelope。若存在 `workspace_audit.llm_triage.{provider,model}` 则优先使用它们，否则使用配置中的 primary provider 和 model；也可用 `--llm-provider` / `--llm-model` 覆盖。若 provider 是本地的（如 Ollama），envelope 也不会离开本机
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-140-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/security.md-141-如果希望 audit triage 使用更小或本地的模型，而不改变普通 agent 模型，可以配置：

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-130-## Media Transcription
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-131-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md:132:`POST /media/transcribe` is intended for local orchestrators. It requires the same bearer-token auth as `/webhook` and `/a2a`, and uses the configured `tools.media.audio` STT model.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-133-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-134-Request:
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-159-- Only `audio/*` MIME types are accepted.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-160-- Raise `gateway.max_body_size_bytes`, `gateway.request_timeout_secs`, and `gateway.webhook_rate_limit_per_minute` for live desktop audio chunking.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md:161:- `tools.media.audio.models[0]` selects the STT provider/model/endpoint. If that provider has no key, NullClaw falls back to a keyed OpenAI/Groq/Telnyx provider when available.
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/en/gateway-api.md-162-- Custom STT endpoints must be HTTPS for remote hosts; plain HTTP is accepted only for local/private endpoints and URLs with query or fragment parts are rejected.

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-145-常见原因：

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-170-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md:171:### 6) 本地 Ollama 模型提示没有 `scheduler_tool` 权限
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-172-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-173-这通常意味着：
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-174-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-175-- NullClaw 里的规范工具名其实是 `schedule`。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md:176:- 某些通过 Ollama 提供的本地模型会输出 `scheduler_tool` 或 `schedule_tool`。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-177-- 新版 NullClaw 会在分发前把这些 Ollama 别名规范化回 `schedule`。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/usage.md-178-

runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-138-### `agent.default_queue_mode`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-139-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md:140:- 设置新建会话的入站队列模式。可选值为 `off`、`serial`、`latest` 和 `debounce`，默认值为 `off`。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md:141:- `off` 会丢弃正在执行回合时到达的消息，`serial` 会等待当前回合结束，`latest` 会保留最新的待注入消息。`debounce` 选择现有的运行时 debounce 模式；此字段不配置其时长、容量或丢弃策略。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-142-- `/queue` 可以覆盖当前会话的模式。`/queue reset`、`/restart` 和 `/debug reset` 会恢复这里配置的默认值。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md:143:- 修改后需要重启，确保 session manager 与后续新建会话使用同一个默认值。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-144-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-145-示例：
--
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-148-{
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-149-  "agent": {
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md:150:    "default_queue_mode": "latest"
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-151-  }
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-152-}
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-153-```
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-154-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md:155:### `workspace_audit.llm_triage`
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-156-
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md:157:- 选择 `nullclaw workspace audit --llm-triage external` 使用的 provider/model。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-158-- 该配置本身不会启用 LLM triage；命令行模式仍然必须显式开启。
runtime/cde-20260926/external/nullclaw-docs/docs/zh/configuration.md-159-- 省略时回退到 `agents.defaults.model.primary`。
